**Versions:** Minecraft, Java, Fabric Loader, Fabric API, KTHREADD.

**Reproduction:** Steps, expected result, actual result, relevant module settings.

**Other mods:** Especially Creepy SalHack and rendering/shader mods.

**Evidence:** Screenshots and sanitized crash report/latest.log. Remove account data, private server addresses and personal paths before posting.
